name: Tesseract Joint Target
description: Build an exact native Tesseract JointTarget in native revolute/prismatic joint units.

inputParameters.name: positions
inputParameters.description: Ordered joint positions in native joint units: radians for revolute joints and metres for prismatic joints.

inputParameters.name: joint_names
inputParameters.description: Optional exact joint-name order. When omitted, Tesseract Motion Program supplies the selected native group's order.

inputParameters.name: move_type
inputParameters.description: Exact native move type: FREESPACE, LINEAR, or CIRCULAR. Defaults to FREESPACE.

inputParameters.name: profile
inputParameters.description: Exact non-empty Tesseract motion-profile name. Defaults to DEFAULT.

outputParameters.name: target
outputParameters.description: Exact native tesseract_robotics.planning.JointTarget retaining supplied order and move type.
